import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
forms={
 'ln+poly+Teps': lambda p: p[0]*np.log(1+p[1]*eps)+p[2]*eps+p[3]*eps**2+p[4]*T*eps+p[5]*T,
 'Voce+Hollo': lambda p: p[0]*eps**p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*eps)+p[3]*(1-np.exp(-p[4]*eps))*(1+p[5]*T),
 'sat': lambda p: p[0]*(1-np.exp(-p[1]*eps))+p[2]*eps**p[3]*(1+p[4]*T),
 'powlog': lambda p: p[0]*np.log(1+p[1]*eps)**p[2]*(1+p[3]*T),
 'ln2': lambda p: p[0]*np.log(1+p[1]*eps)+p[2]*np.log(1+p[3]*eps)**2*(1+p[4]*T),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for k,fn in forms.items():
    best=None
    for t in range(40):
        p0=rng.uniform(0.2,3,6)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: fn(p)-sigma,p0,max_nfev=3000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as ex: pass
    print(k, np.mean((fn(best.x)-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma), best.x.round(5))
